description:
Manage person files; people are link targets for note participants and task assignees, never threads.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list person files; open only by default
  show PERSON [--json] — show a single person file
  new [--name NAME] [--category professional|personal|voluntary] — create a person file (INTERACTIVE for any field not supplied)
  delete PERSON [-y] — permanently delete a person file (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  list: --all include closed people; --json JSON output. QUERY is an optional fuzzy search that ranks by similarity.
  show: --json JSON output. PERSON is the full name, matching the filename without .md.
  new: --name full name; --category one of professional, personal, voluntary.
  delete: -y skip the confirmation prompt.

Examples:
  ["list", "--json"]
  ["show", "Riaz Arbi", "--json"]
  ["new", "--name", "Charlie Smith", "--category", "professional"]
  ["delete", "Charlie Smith", "-y"]

Notes:
  `new` prompts on stdin for any field not passed as a flag. Always pass both --name and --category so it never prompts.
  `delete` prompts for confirmation unless -y is given.
  A person file must exist before `tasks set-assignee` or an ACTION assignee will resolve.
